items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: He still knows my music better than anybody else. All the compositions.

ctx.x: He's a very tasty player. In my bands,

How about Danny? Danny's been with you for a long time, and I never have heard anybody who -- I mean, he really is the other half of your heartbeat sometimes. I mean, he just knows what you're going to do.

He used to be, but in the last five years, I wouldn't say that. He's auditioning for a rock band all the time. Hoping some rock players will hear him. He stopped playing my music a long time ago. He was still playing the basic part of it, but his choice of cymbals and his beat is rock. (Inaudible) or that little kid that played with Miles Davis.
